WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.

4. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.

5. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.

6. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.

7. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Manufactured boards.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Manufactured boards.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Manufactured boards.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Manufactured boards.

8. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.

11. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.

12. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Drawing.

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

14. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

15. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Finishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Project activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Detailed drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Trends in woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Health and Safety in the Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
